evals.name: named-svg
evals.prompt: Download the Material Symbols home icon as an SVG and save it to ./icons/home.svg.
evals.expected_output: An SVG file at ./icons/home.svg containing a recognizable house path; default outlined family, 24px.

evals.name: descriptive-search
evals.prompt: I'm building a settings screen and need a Material icon that means 'sync this to the cloud' — something that suggests uploading or syncing data to cloud storage. Find a couple of options, pick the most popular one, and save it as an SVG in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Script first calls search.sh with cloud/sync/upload keywords, presents options, then downloads (e.g. cloud_sync or cloud_upload) as an SVG.

evals.name: non-default-svg
evals.prompt: Get me the favorite icon as a 48px SVG, filled, with weight 700, in color #e91e63 (pink). Save it to ./out/favorite-pink.svg.
evals.expected_output: An SVG file at ./out/favorite-pink.svg with fill='#e91e63', size 48, fill axis 1, weight 700.

evals.name: android-drawable
evals.prompt: I need an Android vector drawable for the settings gear icon, rounded family. Save it to ./res/drawable/ic_settings.xml.
evals.expected_output: An Android XML drawable at ./res/drawable/ic_settings.xml with <vector> root, rounded path data.
